request: The supremum of the weighted vanishing orders of integer polynomials with bounded coefficients at a reduced rational point is at most log B divided by r log q.

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_le
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f ≠ 0 → MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f ≤ ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d)

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [Semiring R] → (σ → ℕ) → MvPowerSeries σ R → ℕ∞

items.name: PowerSeries.le_weightedOrder_subst
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {τ : Type u_3} {S : Type u_4} [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S]
  {a : MvPowerSeries τ S} (w : τ → ℕ),
  PowerSeries.HasSubst a →
    ∀ (f : PowerSeries R),
      f.order * MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w a ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (PowerSeries.subst a f)

items.name: analyticOrderAt_add_eq_right_of_lt
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f g : 𝕜 → E} {z₀ : 𝕜},
  analyticOrderAt g z₀ < analyticOrderAt f z₀ → analyticOrderAt (f + g) z₀ = analyticOrderAt g z₀

items.name: MvPowerSeries.nat_le_weightedOrder
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ},
  (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (Finsupp.weight w) d < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0) → ↑n ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f

items.name: MvPowerSeries.le_weightedOrder_map
